caption: the psp emulator - henrik rydgård's psp-in-a-window, the door for this site's whole psp vault.
about: Ppsspp is the playstation portable emulator every psp page in this catalogue plays through: install it, point it at the rom, and the handheld's library runs upscaled on windows at resolutions the original screen never dreamed of. It needs no bios - the psp firmware handling is built in - and the per-game settings cover the handful of titles that need special handling.
The official download page always serves the current stable build, so the link here stays semi-direct: no version pinned, no stale installer. The getting-started docs carry the setup path.
